candidates.name: Anaplastic thyroid cancer
support_spans: a large, firm, mildly tender mass on the right side of the neck without fixation; the Pemberton sign was positive.

Ultrasound of the thyroid revealed a right lobe volume of 50 mL and left lobe 7.3 mL; the entire right lobe was replaced by a hypo- to anechoic mass measuring approximately 6 × 4 × 6 cm, displacing the trachea 1 cm to the left, with no pathological lymphadenopathy.
candidates.why: The large and firm mass, positive Pemberton sign, and significant tracheal displacement suggest an aggressive thyroid cancer, such as anaplastic thyroid cancer.
